triples.subject: Fenya
triples.quote: Fenya asked her mistress: “Is the gentleman going to stay the night, mistress?” “Yes; make him a bed on the sofa,” answered Grushenka.

triples.subject: Grushenka
triples.quote: betrothed to a man who had been arrested for a terrible crime, almost at the instant of their betrothal, in spite of her illness and the almost inevitable sentence hanging over Mitya

triples.subject: Grushenka
triples.quote: We quarreled again, would you believe it? Whenever I go we quarrel.” Grushenka said all this in one breath in her agitation.

triples.subject: Grushenka
triples.quote: The object of that uneasiness was the same as ever—Katerina Ivanovna, of whom Grushenka had even raved when she lay in delirium. Alyosha knew that she was fearfully jealous of her.

triples.subject: Mitya
triples.quote: He loves you, that’s what it is: he loves you so much. And now he is particularly worried.

triples.subject: Grushenka
triples.quote: Alyosha went towards the cathedral square to the widow Morozov’s house to see Grushenka

triples.subject: Mitya
triples.quote: Only fancy, he is jealous of the Pole. ‘Why are you keeping him?’ he said. ‘So you’ve begun keeping him.’ He is jealous, jealous of me all the time, jealous eating and sleeping!

triples.subject: Pan Mussyalovitch
triples.quote: In the letter was enclosed a receipt for the sum, with a promise to repay it within three months, signed by Pan Vrublevsky as well.

triples.subject: Ivan Fyodorovitch
triples.quote: No, it’s not Rakitin; it’s his brother Ivan Fyodorovitch upsetting him.

triples.subject: Mitya
triples.quote: First, that he loves you, loves you more than any one in the world, and you only, believe me.

triples.subject: Mitya
triples.quote: So he loves her, if he’ll praise her to my face, more shame to him!

triples.subject: Ivan Fyodorovitch
triples.quote: A week ago he suddenly told me that Ivan was in love with Katerina, because he often goes to see her.

triples.subject: Mitya
triples.quote: He’s treated me badly himself, so he attacked me, to make out I am in fault first and to throw it all on me.

triples.subject: Mitya
triples.quote: prove that Mitya’s mad and committed the murder when he didn’t know what he was doing
